# Review

## Outcome

**Request Changes**

## Evidence

- Verified death-routing implementation paths in crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:626-656, crates/tank_core/src/systems/plant_growth.rs:387-416, and crates/tank_core/src/systems/algae_growth.rs:277-279.
- Verified the new routing parameter and invariant enforcement in crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:211-219 and crates/tank_core/src/invariants.rs:215-222; targeted validation/save-load tests for invalid values also passed.
- Targeted tests passed: cargo test --test budget_tracking test_shrimp_death_routes_body_mass_to_detritus_and_conserves_n_c -- --exact; cargo test --test budget_tracking test_shrimp_death_detritus_amount_matches_expected_body_mass -- --exact; cargo test --test budget_tracking test_plant_loss_routing_is_clamped_to_available_biomass_and_stays_particulate -- --exact; cargo test --test budget_tracking test_algae_loss_routing_is_clamped_to_available_biomass_and_stays_particulate -- --exact; cargo test --test budget_tracking test_high_mortality_200_hours_conserves_n_c_and_accumulates_detritus -- --exact; cargo test --test shrimp_feeding_pathway shrimp_mortality_transfers_reserve_to_detritus -- --exact; cargo test --test validation step_hours_rejects_out_of_range_death_biomass_fraction_before_simulation -- --exact; cargo test --test validation step_hours_rejects_sub_unity_death_biomass_fraction_without_export_path -- --exact; cargo test --test save_load malformed_v4_save_with_out_of_range_death_biomass_fraction_is_rejected -- --exact.

## Findings and Gaps

- High: Shrimp mortality still derives carcass stoichiometry from the global food-quality ratio instead of shrimp-specific body-composition data. The routing path in crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:644-646 calls live_biomass_detrital_mass_g(..., state.process_params.feed_n_to_c_ratio), and the shrimp budget helpers in crates/tank_core/src/types/budget.rs:414-453 do the same. The documented shrimp body-composition constants in crates/tank_core/src/types/budget.rs:18-35 are not wired into behavior or budget accounting, so changing feed_n_to_c_ratio changes dead-shrimp composition. That does not satisfy the bead requirement for named shrimp body-composition parameters driving death routing.
- Medium: The required 200-hour integration coverage does not actually verify detritus accumulation. Despite its name/comment, crates/tank_core/tests/budget_tracking.rs:1187-1298 never records or asserts fine_detritus or any detrital pool change; it only checks N/C drift and final population decline. The acceptance criterion explicitly asks to verify detritus accumulates as mortality proceeds.

## Follow-up and Amendments

- Introduce shrimp-specific body-composition fields/constants in species or process data, use them in shrimp death routing and shrimp budget accounting instead of feed_n_to_c_ratio, and update the exact-detritus test in crates/tank_core/tests/budget_tracking.rs:1167-1179 to assert against those shrimp-specific values.
- Amend the 200-hour mortality integration test to capture detritus at one or more checkpoints and assert that mortality causes an increase in fine_detritus, or total in-tank detrital particulate mass, while the existing N/C conservation assertions continue to hold.
